message:
fix: prepare 0.6.1 with reliable HDL replay and setup diagnostics

Preserve verified replay checkpoint timestamps for stable Verilog outputs without manufacturing signal transitions.

Recognize executable HDL fences without an executor in full educational profiles and show actionable setup diagnostics while preserving explicit host authorization. Add cancellable capability discovery and clearer HTTP, authentication, CORS and endpoint errors.

Audit all 78 HDL fences across Portuguese, English and Spanish with real GHDL, Icarus/VVP and Yosys tools. Update multilingual prerequisites, replay documentation and the application integration guide with a tested configuration candidate.

Validate 69 backend tests without skips and 21 production distribution tests, plus engine regressions, application compatibility, lint, types, build and package contents. Advance package and lockfile versions to 0.6.1.

Map public package imports to source entry points in Jest so integration tests run after clean:all without a prebuilt distribution.
